gap: No result ChatGPT got states that none of the 10.24 kWh battery options in Sun Gold Power's SGR-8K10E kit (2× SG48100P or 1× SG48200T) is self-heating, and that the store bundles its self-heating SGH48100T battery (heater turns on below 41°F/5°C and off at 53.6°F/12°C) only in its 20 kWh-and-up 'T' kits, so a tiny home whose battery sits in an unheated closet or box needs the batteries bought separately.
standout_why: I opened the Current Connected EG4/Fortress TinyHome kit page, which ChatGPT got as result 10. It lists the batteries, inverter and cables but says nothing about low-temperature charging or heating for the Eneramp batteries in the kit. Neither ChatGPT answer mentions cold-weather charging or battery heating, and the only cold-climate caveat they give is 'winter sunlight'. I could not open the cited Renogy cabin-kit page or the tiny-home-kits collection: every attempt returned HTTP 429 on 2026-11-10. A Renogy self-heating 48V battery exists, so the cited Renogy page may cover part of this. That uncertainty is why the score is 2 and not 3.
kit_items: Inverter/charger (48 V, 120/240 V split phase, built-in MPPT): the Sun Gold Power 8 kW SPH inverter that comes in the SGR-8K10E. It gives 120/240 V output for a tiny home with 240 V loads, and its PV input takes up to 500 VDC open-circuit, so the 8 included panels can be wired in high-voltage strings.

Battery (51.2 V LiFePO4, about 10 kWh): 2× Sun Gold Power SGH48100T self-heating. Its maker page says the heater starts below 41°F (5°C) and stops at 53.6°F (12°C). Choose it over the kit's SG48100P or SG48200T, whose maker pages list no heating, when the battery bank sits somewhere unheated.
Solar array: 8× Sun Gold Power 450 W bifacial N-type panels (3.6 kW total, 30.08 V Vmp each), with Z-brackets, 50 ft PV extension cables and PV and DC breakers. All of these are in the SGR-8K10E box.

Smaller tiny-home alternative: the Sun Gold Power SGM-5K5E (5 kW inverter with 120 V output only, 1× 5.12 kWh battery, 6× 200 W panels). It suits lights, a fridge and fans, but it can't run 240 V appliances.
Plug-and-play alternative with no wiring of an inverter: the BLUETTI Apex 200 + B500K expansion battery + 2× 500 W panels bundle from BLUETTI's own store.
